title: Sentry – Error Monitoring
description: Sentry's website is a developer monitoring platform page with a distinctive dark orange and grey theme. The hero features a product dashboard screenshot with real-looking data, immediately showing the value proposition. Feature cards use icon plus title plus description with accent borders in the brand orange. Stats counters display platform metrics with animated number transitions. The page uses a clean developer-focused messaging style without excessive marketing language. Integration logos appear in a grid format showing framework and platform support. The dark theme with orange accent creates a distinctive brand identity that stands out from the typical blue SaaS theme.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for developer tools and monitoring platforms needing a data-heavy dark theme page with dashboard previews and integration showcases.
style_vibe: Dark developer platform with a signature orange accent — professional, data-heavy, and integration-rich.
